decisions.reason: As the homepage flagship and announced strategic focus, Product B carries the highest public commitment and centrality, so escalation strongly favors keeping it.
Although Product C is less visible and less central, it has received continued investment and public presentation on its own page, so escalation still favors keeping it.

Product D is the newest and least publicly committed, mentioned only on the website and building on established services, so escalation pressures are weaker, though the firm has still invested enough to lean toward keeping it.
